versions.changelog:
depth-of-field-control v0.1.0

- Initial release with detailed method for controlling photographic depth of field.
- Provides clear summary and application of aperture, focal length, and focus distance in depth-of-field control, based on《纽约摄影学院摄影教程》第三章.
- Outlines when to trigger this skill and distinguishes it from related skills (exposure and focus issues).
- Includes executable step-by-step instructions and boundary cases for practical guidance.
- Lists common user scenarios and language cues for invoking this skill.
